resources.string: Here you can launch Google Play to review and manage (e.g. terminate) your tunnel subscription.

The following status is determined from the Google account that your device is linked to. Retrieving the status may take a few seconds. If valid until date is reached, subscription will be extended (with the monthly fee), unless you terminated the subscription.

Here you can subscribe to a set of 4 tunnels with a few clicks. The subscription process is entirely handled by Google, including credit card or other payment details. You will be shown the exact price for your region. First time users have a full 60 days free testing period! After the free period, the subscription is extended automatically each month, with the indicated monthly fee in the indicated currency.
